notes.task1: Full-source unsafe judgments describe model judgments, not error or ethical quality. Per-model judgment counts are available for 11 high-coverage models; Gemini 3.1 Pro has coverage only.
notes.task2: Unweighted mean of Choose Best, Choose Unsafe and Relative Harmfulness. Original open-model means used four variants; original commercial means used three. No answer counts are inferred from rounded percentages.
notes.task3: Original 13,552 prompts/model; inspect classified/all rates and generation skips. Classifier proxy, not independent safety ground truth.
notes.task4: Descriptive strategy inclusion; no quality direction. Released heatmap contains selected strategies, not all 15 labels.
notes.task5: Unsafe calls / all expected rows, pooled across three simulated tool-choice framings, with separate framing rows. No real tools executed.
notes.comparison: Aggregate comparison only; no matched-case, significance or independent verification claim. Do not pool with current protocol registrations.
